name: xule-site
description: Personal website - book aesthetic, algorithmic age

scripts.build: bun run build:site && bun run verify
scripts.build:site: bun scripts/gen-og-cards.mjs && rm -rf _site && eleventy && bunx pagefind --site _site && bun scripts/build-freshness.mjs --write
scripts.verify: bun run freshness:check && bun run og:lint && bun run renderings:lint && bun run built-json:lint && bun run artifact:test && bun run play:test && bun run sitemap:test && bun run sitemap:lint
scripts.test:making: bun run freshness:check && playwright test tests/making
